truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 found 7 of 20 true vulnerabilities, partially found 2, and missed 11. It also included 1 false positive (Sandboxing Disabled by Default). Several critical vulnerabilities were missed including Use-After-Free, Integer Underflow, and Logic Bomb.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Format String Vulnerability in log_debug_message" with evidence: "std::string active_format = runtime_log_format(); printf(active_format.c_str(), user_input);"
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the format-string injection via runtime_log_format() and printf with user-controlled format string. CWE-134 matches exactly.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: N/A - not found in Run 2 findings
Items.Notes: The integer overflow in factorial computation (result *= i with no overflow check) was not identified in Run 2.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: N/A - not found in Run 2 findings
Items.Notes: The use-after-free in stage_deferred_history_flush where scratch is allocated, enqueued to thread pool, then g_memory_pool.cleanup() is called in cleanup() before threads finish was not identified.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Command Injection via system() in ConfigLoader::validate_config" with evidence: "std::string command = validator_cmd + \" \" + config_file; int result = system(command.c_str());"
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified command injection via config validation. Severity was listed as High instead of Critical, but the vulnerability was found.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Buffer Overflow in evaluate_expression with strcpy" with evidence: "if (expression.length() >= sizeof(input_buffer_)) { strcpy(input_buffer_, expression.c_str()); }"
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the stack buffer overflow in evaluate_expression. CWE-120 matches.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Race Condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment" with evidence: "long long old_value = value_; std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(mutex_); value_ = old_value + 1;"
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the race condition. Severity was listed as Low instead of Medium, but the vulnerability was found.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: N/A - not found in Run 2 findings
Items.Notes: The logic bomb in authentication (login_attempts_ > 5 with EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE bypass) was not identified.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: N/A - not found in Run 2 findings
Items.Notes: Path traversal in config loading (config_dir_ + filename without sanitization) was not identified.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Buffer Overflow via strcpy in ExpressionParser::parse" with evidence: "buffer_size_ = 256; expression_buffer_ = static_cast<char*>(memory::g_memory_pool.allocate(buffer_size_)); strcpy(expression_buffer_, expr_str.c_str());"
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified the heap overflow in the expression parser but classified it as CWE-120 (stack/heap buffer overflow) instead of CWE-122 (heap buffer overflow). The vulnerability was found but with incorrect CWE classification.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Hardcoded Admin Secret" with evidence: "constexpr char ADMIN_SECRET[] = \"SC_ENT_2025_AUTH\";"
Items.Notes: Run 2 correctly identified the hardcoded admin credentials. CWE-798 matches exactly.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote: "Weak Session Token Generation" with evidence: "std::mt19937 gen(rd()); std::uniform_int_distribution<> dis(1000, 9999);"
Items.Notes: Run 2 identified weak session token generation but classified it as CWE-330 (weak cryptography) instead of CWE-338 (weak PRNG). The vulnerability was found but with incorrect CWE.

Items.Notes: Thread-unsafe timestamp cache using static std::tm cached_time with localtime() was not identified.
